items.stem: In June 2025, who became the first Indian astronaut to visit the International Space Station (Axiom-4 mission)?
items.explanation: Group Captain Shubhanshu Shukla of the Indian Air Force flew on Axiom Mission 4 in June 2025 and spent about two weeks on the ISS.

distractors.b: He was the first Indian in space, in 1984, aboard a Soviet mission; there was no ISS then.
distractors.c: She is a NASA astronaut of Indian origin, not an Indian astronaut.
distractors.d: A Gaganyaan astronaut-designate who was the backup for Axiom-4.

items.takeaway: First Indian on the ISS: Shubhanshu Shukla (Ax-4, 2025).

items.stem: With the SpaDeX mission in January 2025, India became which country to dock two satellites in space?

options.text: The fourth, after the USA, Russia and China

items.explanation: ISRO's Space Docking Experiment (SpaDeX) joined two small satellites in orbit, a key step for Gaganyaan and a future Indian space station.

distractors.c: The USA and Russia did it decades earlier.
distractors.d: Russia (then the USSR) and the USA came first.
distractors.a: Only three countries had done it before India.

items.takeaway: SpaDeX 2025: India is the 4th country to dock in space.

items.stem: NISAR, the Earth-observation satellite launched in July 2025, is a joint mission of ISRO and:
items.explanation: NISAR (NASA-ISRO Synthetic Aperture Radar) maps Earth's land and ice surfaces in fine detail. It was launched from Sriharikota on a GSLV rocket.

distractors.a: The European Space Agency is not a partner in NISAR.
distractors.b: Japan's agency partnered India on other missions, not NISAR.

items.stem: The Chenab Rail Bridge, opened in 2025 and called the world's highest railway arch bridge, is in which state or union territory?
items.explanation: The steel arch bridge stands about 359 m above the Chenab river, higher than the Eiffel Tower, and links Kashmir to the rest of India's rail network.

distractors.b: The bridge is on the Udhampur–Srinagar–Baramulla line.

items.takeaway: World's highest rail arch bridge: Chenab, J&K.

items.stem: The New Pamban Bridge, opened in April 2025 as India's first vertical-lift railway sea bridge, connects the mainland to:
items.explanation: A central span lifts straight up so ships can pass underneath. It replaced the 1914 Pamban bridge.

distractors.c: That's an island far out at sea.

items.takeaway: Vertical-lift sea bridge: New Pamban, Rameswaram.

items.stem: Operation Sindoor (May 2025) was India's military response to the terror attack at:
items.explanation: After the April 2025 attack on tourists at Pahalgam, India struck terror camps in Pakistan and Pakistan-administered Kashmir in Operation Sindoor.

distractors.a: The Pulwama attack was in 2019 (followed by the Balakot strike).
distractors.b: The Uri attack was in 2016 (followed by surgical strikes).
distractors.c: Not the site of this attack.

items.stem: The Maha Kumbh Mela of 2025 was held at:
items.explanation: The 2025 Maha Kumbh at the confluence of the Ganga, Yamuna and mythical Saraswati drew record crowds. Managing such crowds is a huge design and planning challenge.

distractors.d: Haridwar hosts Kumbh too, but not the 2025 Maha Kumbh.
distractors.a: Nashik hosts Simhastha Kumbh in other years.
distractors.b: Ujjain hosts Simhastha Kumbh in other years.

items.stem: The terminal of Navi Mumbai International Airport, opened in 2025, takes its form from the:
items.explanation: The terminal by Zaha Hadid Architects uses lotus-petal forms for its roof and columns, linking the building to India's national flower.

items.stem: Under the GST reform that came into effect in September 2025, most goods fall into which two main tax slabs?
items.explanation: 'GST 2.0' cut most items to 5% or 18%, with a separate higher rate for luxury and 'sin' goods.

distractors.a: These slabs were removed or merged in the reform.
distractors.b: These were never the main slabs.
distractors.c: 12% was merged into the other slabs.

items.stem: Hyderabad hosted which international pageant in May 2025?
items.explanation: The 72nd Miss World final took place in Hyderabad, Telangana; Opal Suchata Chuangsri of Thailand won.

distractors.b: It was the global Miss World final.

items.stem: Which Indian city was chosen to host the 2030 Commonwealth Games?
items.explanation: Commonwealth Sport approved Ahmedabad (home of NID) as the 2030 host, the centenary edition of the Games.

items.stem: Who was elected Vice-President of India in September 2025?
items.explanation: C. P. Radhakrishnan, earlier Governor of Maharashtra, became India's 15th Vice-President.

distractors.c: He resigned in July 2025, which led to the election.
distractors.a: He is the Speaker of the Lok Sabha.

items.stem: Who became Chief Justice of India in November 2025?
items.explanation: Justice Surya Kant became the 53rd Chief Justice of India.

distractors.d: He was Chief Justice before him, from May to November 2025.
distractors.b: He was Chief Justice from late 2024 to May 2025.

items.stem: In May 2025 the Catholic Church elected Pope Leo XIV. He is the first pope from which country?
items.explanation: Robert Francis Prevost, born in Chicago, was elected after Pope Francis died in April 2025.

distractors.c: Pope Francis, his predecessor, was from Argentina.
distractors.d: He worked for many years in Peru and is also its citizen, but he was born in Chicago.

items.takeaway: Pope Leo XIV: first pope from the USA.

items.stem: Who became Prime Minister of Canada in March 2025?
items.explanation: Mark Carney, a former governor of the Bank of Canada and the Bank of England, replaced Justin Trudeau and then won the April 2025 election.

distractors.c: He led the New Democratic Party.

items.stem: In October 2025, Sanae Takaichi became the first woman to hold which office?
items.explanation: Sanae Takaichi became Japan's first woman Prime Minister.

distractors.c: The UK has had women Prime Ministers before.

items.takeaway: Japan's first woman PM: Sanae Takaichi (2025).

items.stem: Who began his second term as President of the United States in January 2025?
items.explanation: Donald Trump became the 47th president, after also serving as the 45th (2017–2021).

items.stem: 'Heart Lamp', winner of the International Booker Prize 2025, was translated from which Indian language?
items.explanation: Banu Mushtaq's short stories, translated by Deepa Bhasthi, became the first Kannada book to win the prize.

distractors.c: Geetanjali Shree's 'Tomb of Sand', the 2022 winner, was in Hindi.

items.stem: Which Hindi writer received the Jnanpith Award announced in 2025?
items.explanation: Vinod Kumar Shukla, from Chhattisgarh, is known for 'Naukar Ki Kameez' and his gentle, unusual style.

distractors.d: He shared the Jnanpith announced in 2024.
distractors.a: She was a Bengali writer who won much earlier.

items.stem: Who won the Nobel Peace Prize 2025?
items.explanation: The prize honoured Venezuela's opposition leader for her struggle for democracy.

items.stem: Who won the Nobel Prize in Literature 2025?
items.explanation: The Hungarian novelist is known for long, intense sentences and dark, visionary books.

items.stem: The Pritzker Architecture Prize, often called architecture's Nobel, went in 2025 to:
items.explanation: Chinese architect Liu Jiakun is known for buildings that respond to everyday life, local materials and community, such as the West Village in Chengdu.

items.stem: World Expo 2025 was held in which city?
items.explanation: Expo 2025 Osaka, Kansai had the theme 'Designing Future Society for Our Lives'.

items.stem: The 'Grand Ring' at Expo 2025 Osaka, recognised as the world's largest wooden architectural structure, was designed by:
items.explanation: The 2 km ring of timber, built with traditional Japanese joinery, framed the Expo site and showed how wood can build at a huge scale.

distractors.d: Another Japanese architect known for wood, but not the Grand Ring.
distractors.a: Known for concrete, not this ring.

items.takeaway: Expo 2025's Grand Ring: Sou Fujimoto, timber.

items.stem: Who curated the 2025 Venice Architecture Biennale, titled 'Intelligens. Natural. Artificial. Collective.'?
items.explanation: Italian architect-engineer Carlo Ratti asked how natural, artificial and collective intelligence can help us adapt to a changing climate.

items.stem: Which region holds the title World Design Capital for 2026?
items.explanation: World Design Capital is awarded by the World Design Organization to cities that use design to improve life.

distractors.b: Valencia was World Design Capital in 2022.

items.stem: Where was the UN climate summit COP30 held in November 2025?
items.explanation: Belém sits at the edge of the Amazon rainforest, which put forests at the centre of the talks.

items.stem: The 2026 Winter Olympics were held in:
items.explanation: The Games were shared between the city of Milan and the mountain resort of Cortina.

items.stem: The 2026 FIFA World Cup is jointly hosted by:
items.explanation: It is the first World Cup with 48 teams and the first hosted by three countries.

distractors.a: Saudi Arabia is set to host in 2034.

items.takeaway: FIFA World Cup 2026: USA, Canada, Mexico (48 teams).

items.stem: Which team won the ICC Champions Trophy 2025?
items.explanation: India beat New Zealand in the final to win their third Champions Trophy.

distractors.c: They lost to India in the final in Dubai.

items.stem: In June 2025, which team won its first-ever IPL title?
items.explanation: RCB beat Punjab Kings in the final, ending an 18-year wait for a title.

distractors.a: They have won several titles before.

items.stem: Who won the ICC Women's Cricket World Cup 2025?
items.explanation: India, led by Harmanpreet Kaur, won their first Women's World Cup, beating South Africa in the final at Navi Mumbai.

distractors.b: Australia has won it many times, but not in 2025.
distractors.d: They lost to India in the final.

items.takeaway: Women's World Cup 2025: India's first title.

items.stem: In December 2024, D. Gukesh became the youngest undisputed world champion in which sport?
items.explanation: At 18, Gukesh beat Ding Liren of China to become World Chess Champion.

items.stem: Divya Deshmukh won the FIDE Women's World Cup 2025 by beating which Indian player in the final?
items.explanation: The all-Indian final made Divya, aged 19, the champion and a grandmaster.
items.takeaway: Women's World Cup 2025: Divya Deshmukh beat Koneru Humpy.

items.stem: In 2025, Neeraj Chopra threw beyond which distance in javelin for the first time?
items.explanation: His throw of 90.23 m at the Doha Diamond League in May 2025 broke the 90 m barrier.

distractors.d: Nobody throws the modern javelin that far.
distractors.a: He had thrown beyond 85 m many times before.

items.stem: Who won the men's singles title at Wimbledon 2025?
items.explanation: Sinner became the first Italian to win the Wimbledon singles title.

distractors.a: He has won Wimbledon many times, but not in 2025.
distractors.b: He won in 2023 and 2024 and lost the 2025 final.

items.stem: Which team won the men's Asia Cup cricket tournament in September 2025?
items.explanation: India beat Pakistan in the final in Dubai.

distractors.b: They lost to India in the final.
